title: Intelligence Engine: Freshness & Gaps
subtitle: Scoring system for what to teach next based on coverage and recency
key_concept: Automated freshness scoring and coverage gap analysis to guide coaching decisions
visual_metaphor: A stained-glass window with panes of varying brightness — dim panes indicate stale topics, dark gaps show missing coverage, amber glow highlights optimal next topics
highlights: Freshness score per topic based on last taught date
why_it_matters: Transforms raw session data into actionable teaching intelligence, replacing gut feel with data-driven decisions
zone_change: Border crossed: from Data Collection to Decision Support — intelligence layer now active
